title: Fractional Clock Divider with DSM
text: Delta Sigma Modulator based fractional clock divider, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Delta Sigma Modulator order} sets Order of the Delta Sigma Modulator 3rd; {Enable increased buffer size} and {Buffer size} sets the number of samples of the input buffering available during. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: div-by
ports.summary: Ratio of output to input clock frequency fractional scalar

params.name: Delta Sigma Modulator order
params.values: Order of the Delta Sigma Modulator 3rd order (default) | 1st order | 2nd order | 4th order

params.name: Enable increased buffer size
params.values: Enable increased buffer size off (default) | on

params.name: Buffer size
params.values: Number of samples of the input buffering available during simulation 1 (default) | positive integer scalar
